This directory contains the exact minified Zod 3.23.8 UMD build used by the
Glam by Mariya registration and login page.

- Package: `zod`
- Version: `3.23.8`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Upstream source: `https://github.com/colinhacks/zod/tree/v3.23.8`
- npm package: `https://registry.npmjs.org/zod/-/zod-3.23.8.tgz`
- Official unminified file: `lib/index.umd.js` (`169,394` bytes)
- Vendored file: `index.umd.min.js` (`61,033` bytes)
- Minification: generated by jsDelivr using Terser `v5.39.0` from the official

- The npm tarball SHA-512 matched the npm registry integrity metadata.
- The official npm `lib/index.umd.js` was byte-identical to the unminified

No SRI attribute is used for this same-origin vendored copy. The original
jsDelivr banner warns against SRI on dynamically generated files; this file is
now a fixed local snapshot.

The retained `sourceMappingURL` points to a jsDelivr-generated map path. It is
only requested by browser developer tools and has no runtime effect.

When updating Zod, replace this entire directory, update the Razor script
reference and CSP tests, and record the new hashes here.
